mapper.select: SELECT pp.* FROM petProduct pp ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC
SELECT pp.* FROM petProduct pp WHERE pp.ProductType = #{productType} ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC
SELECT pp.* FROM petProduct pp JOIN petProductStore pps ON pp.ProductID = pps.ProductID WHERE pps.StoreID = #{storeId} ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC
SELECT * FROM petProduct ORDER BY ProductID DESC
SELECT * FROM petProduct WHERE ProductType = #{productType} ORDER BY ProductID DESC

SELECT pp.ProductID as productId, pp.ProductName as productName, pp.ProductType as productType, pp.Supplier as supplier, pps.RelID as relId, pps.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, pps.Price as price, pps.StoreStock as storeStock, pps.ShelfStatus as shelfStatus FROM petProduct pp LEFT JOIN petProductStore pps ON pp.ProductID = pps.ProductID LEFT JOIN store s ON pps.StoreID = s.StoreID WHERE pps.RelID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC

SELECT pp.ProductID as productId, pp.ProductName as productName, pp.ProductType as productType, pp.Supplier as supplier, pps.RelID as relId, pps.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, pps.Price as price, pps.StoreStock as storeStock, pps.ShelfStatus as shelfStatus FROM petProduct pp LEFT JOIN petProductStore pps ON pp.ProductID = pps.ProductID LEFT JOIN store s ON pps.StoreID = s.StoreID WHERE pps.RelID IS NOT NULL AND pp.ProductType = #{productType} ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC

SELECT pp.ProductID as productId, pp.ProductName as productName, pp.ProductType as productType, pp.Supplier as supplier, pps.RelID as relId, pps.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, pps.Price as price, pps.StoreStock as storeStock, pps.ShelfStatus as shelfStatus FROM petProduct pp LEFT JOIN petProductStore pps ON pp.ProductID = pps.ProductID LEFT JOIN store s ON pps.StoreID = s.StoreID WHERE pps.RelID IS NOT NULL AND (pp.ProductName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp.ProductType LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp.Supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY pp.ProductID DESC
